name: Nizami Handi
steps: Soak cashews 15 minutes in hot water, then blend smooth with 100 ml measured water. Steep saffron in 20 ml warm water. Cut all vegetables to similar size.
Blanch cauliflower, carrot, peas and beans in boiling water for 4 minutes. Add spinach for the final minute, then drain everything; vegetables should stay firm because they cook again in sauce.
Heat ghee in a handi. Cook sliced onion 8 minutes until light golden; add ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute. Stir in tomato puree, coriander powder and garam masala; cook 6 minutes until thick.

Lower heat. Stir in cashew paste and remaining 180 ml water, then whisked yogurt one spoon at a time so the tomato-cashew sauce stays smooth. Add blanched vegetables, spinach and salt; simmer gently 6 minutes.
Add paneer, cream and saffron water. Warm 3 minutes without a hard boil, taste for seasoning and serve in the handi with naan or rice.
tips: A tomato-cashew base, spinach and mixed vegetables distinguish Nizami Handi; keep the yogurt simmer gentle.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
